Auto-opened on the `${TAG}` tag push. Work top to bottom; tick each channel as it reaches **${V}**.

### Build (automatic)
- [ ] `release.yml` built the **draft** release green — `.deb` + AppImage (+`.zsync`) + Windows `setup.exe`/portable + wheel/sdist + `SHA256SUMS`

### Publish — the human gate
- [ ] Review the draft (`gh release view ${TAG} --web`), then `gh release edit ${TAG} --draft=false --latest`

### Fan-out (auto on publish where wired)
- [ ] **PyPI** — auto via `pypi-publish.yml`; verify https://pypi.org/project/jellytoast/ shows ${V}
- [ ] **winget** — auto via `winget.yml` if `WINGET_TOKEN` set, else `wingetcreate update wolfgangwarehaus.jellytoast --version ${V} --urls <setup.exe-url> --submit`
- [ ] **AUR** — auto via `aur.yml` if unfrozen + `AUR_SSH_PRIVATE_KEY` set, else manual (`packaging/aur/README.md`)
- [ ] **Microsoft Store / MSIX** — **manual** on the Windows box (`packaging/msix/STORE-SUBMISSION.md`)
- [ ] **Landing page** — download buttons auto-track `/releases/latest`; bump any version text in `site/` if needed

### Verify
- [ ] `pipx run --no-cache jellytoast --version`, `winget show wolfgangwarehaus.jellytoast`, and `paru -Si jellytoast` each report ${V}
